'''In a Pinch''' was the fourth leg of the dangerous [[Dragonbane circuit]]. This leg took [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]] through a narrow crevasse, winding its way up to a ridge which was steep. Halfway through the leg, the crevasse narrowed to the point that only one [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] could pass through it at a time.

Due to the difficulty this leg caused, seasoned Dragonbane swooper and leader of the [[Black Seraphs]] [[Sunny Bounder/Legends|Sunny Bounder]] would typically make her winning move here, thanks to her skills and the nimbleness of her [[Sunflare|modified]] [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S]].
